product.olivetti-echos-24c.summary: The 24C was the smaller-screen Echos in the March 1995 German announcement.
product.olivetti-echos-24c.history: Computerwoche presented it as an alternative to the 48 Color Plus, due in April or May 1995 at around DM 3,800.
product.olivetti-echos-24c.architecture: The screen made the machine smaller. The report lists 9.4 inches and a 50 MHz 486DX2.
product.olivetti-echos-24c.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-24c.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-echos-24c.market: Computerwoche, 24 March 1995, Olivetti will bei PCs an der Spitze bleiben.
